segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מִצְוַת הַנֶּחְנָקִין: הָיוּ מְשַׁקְּעִין אוֹתוֹ בְּזֶבֶל עַד אַרְכוּבּוֹתָיו, וְנוֹתֵן סוּדָר קָשָׁה לְתוֹךְ הָרַכָּה, וְכוֹרֵךְ עַל צַוָּארוֹ. זֶה מוֹשֵׁךְ אֶצְלוֹ וְזֶה מוֹשֵׁךְ אֶצְלוֹ, עַד שֶׁנַּפְשׁוֹ יוֹצֵאת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The mitzva of those who are strangled» is carried out in the following manner: The agents of the court «submerge» the condemned one «in dung up to his knees» so he cannot move, «and» one of them «places a rough scarf within a soft one, and wraps» it «around his neck. This» one, i.e., one of the witnesses, «pulls» the scarf «toward him, and that» one, the other witness, «pulls» it «toward him, until the soul of» the condemned one «departs.»

positions.claim: the condemned is sunk in dung to the knees and strangled with a soft-wrapped rough scarf pulled from both sides
